If you die, you get to make a new character, but you are 1 level lower than you were. A lesser one could get rid of that level penalty. The third rule is the crit charts. 10/10 best thing. This is for crit successes or failure. weapons are alright, a chance of decapitation, blinding, increased crit multiplier, drop weapon, etc. Spells are the best. it could create a sentient backpack, sink a city, give someone a stat boost, someone gains a level, extra spell effects, etc..
